title: Baixo Limpopo irrigation water-productivity and rainfall-anomaly pilot

geography.name: Baixo Limpopo irrigation area
geography.boundary_source: Current FAO WaPOR catalogue; freeze the exact Level III area/product boundary before intake
geography.spatial_scope_rule: Use a versioned published product footprint or recorded authoritative area polygon; do not infer the irrigation-area boundary from a basemap
geography.cross_border_note: This pilot does not represent the full transboundary Limpopo Basin or all users within it.

question: Within a verified WaPOR Level III Baixo Limpopo product footprint, describe source-supported seasonal water/productivity anomalies and their temporal consistency with CHIRPS v3 rainfall anomalies without claiming causality.
intended_outputs: descriptive aligned time series where common support is sufficient
conditional season-aware anomaly report only when the common record passes D2

sources.native_spatial_support: Product level varies; overview lists global, national/river-basin and selected sub-national products. Confirm actual Level III layer metadata and resolution in the current catalogue.
sources.native_temporal_support: Layer-dependent; temporal frequency and available dates must be read from the selected product metadata.
sources.upstream_overlap: Derived remote-sensing products may share satellite or meteorological inputs with other sources; inspect the selected layer methodology before claiming independent corroboration.
required_checks: exact Level III product/area and layer identifier
current temporal coverage and finality/publication state
units, source CRS, effective spatial resolution and quality mask
source methodology, terms and reuse rights
check the June/July 2024 Level III re-release and March 2025 Baixo Limpopo NPP/AGBP correction history; reacquire affected layers if the selected artifact predates the corrected release

sources.provider: Climate Hazards Center, University of California Santa Barbara
sources.selected_product: Final product required; exact file/release and analysis period are not yet selected
sources.native_spatial_support: 0.05-degree precipitation grid; effective ground distance varies with latitude and grid cells are not local rain gauges.
sources.native_temporal_support: CHIRPS v3 has distinct preliminary and final releases; select exact files and time aggregation only after the WaPOR period is known.
sources.upstream_overlap: CHIRPS blends satellite-based precipitation estimates with in-situ station observations. Candidate validation gauges must be checked against the selected release's station lineage and excluded from the independent test when used in the blend.
required_checks: exact v3 final-product file IDs and publication/retrieval timestamps
citation and CC BY 4.0 attribution retained
valid-data semantics, units, period and temporal aggregation
station-input overlap reviewed for any independent validation claim
sensitivity to product release and aggregation recorded

analysis.estimand: Descriptive co-variation between source-supported seasonal precipitation anomalies and selected WaPOR water/productivity indicators; not a causal effect, yield estimate, or operational metric.
analysis.baseline: Use a predeclared season-aware median and robust spread only if the frozen WaPOR record contains enough complete comparable seasons; otherwise report coverage and raw time series only.
analysis.spatial_alignment: Aggregate finer data to a common defensible support and publish valid-area counts; never rasterize a coarse product to imply finer information.
analysis.temporal_alignment: Compare matching monthly/dekadal windows only where both selected layers support them; preserve period, retrieval time, publication time, and preliminary/final state.
analysis.missingness_policy: Carry source quality masks and no-data separately from zero; report missingness and valid-area fraction before any interpretation.
analysis.independence_policy: Treat source dependence as unresolved until each product's upstream inputs and reference-data overlap are reviewed. WaPOR and CHIRPS are not assumed independent.

independent_reference_candidates: INIR / Plataforma de Irrigação de Moçambique (PIM), announced 2026-06-29: investigate accessible scheme boundaries/operations and dataset terms; an announcement is not evidence of data availability. https://inir.gov.mz/

INIR's June 2026 preliminary Regadio do Baixo Limpopo flood-impact report: candidate event lead only; verify original values, method, date, geometry, and lineage before using as a target. https://inir.gov.mz/

INE Gaza Provincial Statistical Yearbook 2024, crop area/production tables for 2020-2024: province-scale context only, not irrigation-scheme or field-level validation. https://www.ine.gov.mz/documents/20119/334668/ANUARIO_ESTATISTICO_PROVINCIA_GAZA_2024.pdf/facd30cd-f7dc-83ac-1a35-3e92df08ea22?download=true&t=1751365783760&version=1.0
Rain-gauge records whose inclusion in the selected CHIRPS v3 final release has been checked; withhold contributing gauges from any independent test. https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirps3
Irrigation delivery, reservoir/canal operation or scheme records with compatible dates and spatial scope; independently document provenance and any overlap with WaPOR source inputs.
metrics: source coverage and valid-area fraction by season
season-specific anomaly agreement against a frozen baseline when justified
sensitivity to quality masks, temporal windows, aggregation and release vintage
precision/recall or false-alert rate only for a pre-registered threshold with an adequate independent reference

claim_ceiling: No crop-yield, farm-level, farmer-intent or household food-availability claim from remote sensing alone.
No individual well level, exact aquifer depletion or groundwater over-abstraction claim.
No causal attribution from temporal co-variation alone.
No drinking-water access or safety claim from water-productivity layers.
No forecast, irrigation-control authority, water allocation or emergency-aid direction.
Do not call a source independent until its upstream inputs and reference overlap have been reviewed.
